reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept IF condition-1 [THEN] {statement-1 | NEXT SENTENCE} followed by ELSE statement-2 [END-IF], ELSE NEXT SENTENCE, or END-IF (or nothing before the terminal period, SR2), with statement-1/statement-2 each REQUIRED (Amendment 2 removed the ellipsis, statement being an imperative or a conditional optionally preceded by an imperative per SR1), and must refuse a form with an empty consequent or an empty ELSE; the witness covers only the empty-consequent refusal.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.NextSentenceArchaic2002: COBOL0903 archaic warning on NEXT SENTENCE from 2002; silent at 85

reader.edition-search: grep of ifStatement grammar (no edition predicate), ControlFlowBinder.BindIf (none), StatementBinder.IsNextSentenceArm (none), VersionConformancePass for IfStatement/NextSentence (only VisitNextSentenceStatement).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 2023 NEXT SENTENCE draws the COBOL0903 archaic warning; at 85 it is silent. The format shape itself is parsed by one edition-free rule.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises only the empty-consequent refusal; the THEN/ELSE/END-IF/NEXT SENTENCE arms, the SR2 omission and nesting are not exercised at 85 by it

probes.printed: A1 B2 C-NEXT D2 E-NEXT F1 G1 H-AFTER I1 J-NEXT K 4 L2 M1 M2 (no diagnostics; N arm correctly prints nothing)
probes.expected: every arm of the format (THEN optional, ELSE stmt END-IF, NEXT SENTENCE ELSE stmt, stmt ELSE NEXT SENTENCE, bare stmt before period, stmt END-IF, NEXT SENTENCE ELSE NEXT SENTENCE, imperative followed by conditional, nested IF matching per GR3) compiles and runs per GR2

probes.printed: error COBOL2072: unexpected 'END-IF' ... at least one statement shall be specified
error COBOL2269: NEXT SENTENCE ... never beside another statement
probes.expected: refused: NEXT SENTENCE is a whole brace alternative

probes.printed: 85: NEXT-SENTENCE, no diagnostic; 2002 same; 2023: COBOL0903 warning then NEXT-SENTENCE
probes.expected: format-legal (third alternative END-IF after NEXT SENTENCE) but refused by SR3, a separate rule: 'If the END-IF phrase is specified, the NEXT SENTENCE phrase must not be specified'

reader.notes: The format's shape is implemented by one edition-free grammar rule with statementBlock = statement+, and every arm and refusal probed behaves per the 1985 format and GR2/GR3. LEAD for the separate rule §1985:VI.6.16.3 SR3: IF c NEXT SENTENCE END-IF and IF c NEXT SENTENCE ELSE s END-IF compile silently at 85 (and 2002); the grammar comment on ifStatement records this as the PB396 'DETERMINATION' to accept, which contradicts 1985 SR3's explicit prohibition.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.6.16.2-4 and the scope rules §1985:IV.4.4.4, §1985:IV.6.4.2.3.1, §1985:IV.6.4.3. Attack: an IF with neither ELSE nor END-IF that does NOT immediately precede the terminal period (SR2 only excuses that position). Probes at --std 85: E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-002/if_perf.cob (IF c DISPLAY inside inline PERFORM ... END-PERFORM) and E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-002/if_eval.cob (unterminated IF inside EVALUATE WHEN) are both refused COBOL2796; E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-002/if_read.cob (a conditional READ AT END / ADD ON SIZE ERROR as statement-1 implicitly terminated by the IF's ELSE, multi-statement imperative statement-1 and statement-2) printed EOF1 ELSE2 SE Q1 Q2 R1 R2 as GR2 requires; E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-002/if_ns2.cob (IF c THEN NEXT SENTENCE., IF c NEXT SENTENCE., ELSE IF ... NEXT SENTENCE ELSE, stmt ELSE NEXT SENTENCE.) printed A B C D E F; a stray second END-IF is refused COBOL0306. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.16.2 'IF condition-1 THEN NEXT SENTENCE'; OK §1985:VI.6.16.3 SR2; OK §1985:IV.6.4.3; OK §1985:IV.6.4.2.3.1.
